explanation: Measured against the stars, Venus turns once every 243 Earth days, while one trip around the Sun takes about 225 Earth days.

claims.text: Venus's rotation period, measured against the stars, is longer than its orbital period around the Sun.
Venus rotates once, relative to the stars, in about 243 Earth days.
Venus orbits the Sun once in about 225 Earth days.
